text:
Nina Park: Quick alert — during a scheduled embeddings reindex for a small group of customers we observed a model-quality regression causing lower recall on some search/semantic-match queries. It's isolated to accounts that ingested >2M docs in the last 48h and used the 'auto-shard' path.

Samir Roy: Do we know which tenants hit the worst delta? any in renewal window?

Nina Park: Yes — 12 tenants affected, 5 marked as high-touch (renewal in 30-90 days). I've pulled an impact matrix, will attach in the AE one-pager.

Lena Koval: We need a customer-facing note that (a) acknowledges the issue, (b) explains mitigation/rollback, and (c) offers remediation support (assisted reindex + opt-in to manual shard config). Tone should reassure without overpromising.

Diego Romero: For high-touch customers propose: dedicated remediation call within 24 hours, one assisted reindex (no charge), and a commitment to review query metrics with them post-fix. Also suggest a goodwill credit line.

Jules Martin (Legal): Recommended credit phrasing: "We will assess eligibility for goodwill credits or service credits consistent with the terms of your agreement; our team will follow up to confirm." Avoid committing to specific credit amounts in initial outreach.

Nina Park: Draft short email below — please annotate.

```
Hi [Customer],

We discovered an issue during recent embeddings reindexing that has temporarily reduced matching quality for some queries in your account. Our engineers have identified the root cause (regression in auto-shard handling during large reindexes) and are rolling a targeted fix now.

What we're doing:
- Deploying a patch to correct the auto-shard logic and replaying the affected reindexes where needed.
- Offering an assisted reindex (no charge) to restore your embeddings to the expected quality.
- Scheduling a follow-up review with your CS/AE to inspect query accuracy and any downstream impacts.

Next steps: our team will reach out within 12 hours to schedule the assisted reindex and a review call. We will also evaluate eligibility for credits under your agreement and confirm any offer in the follow-up.

We apologize for the disruption and are prioritizing your account.

— Nina, Customer Success
```

Samir Roy: Strong. For the 5 renewal-risk accounts, add: "We're prepared to provide a private walkthrough and extended monitoring post-fix — please let us know preferred times this week."

Lena Koval: I'll draft a one-pager for AEs with suggested messaging snippets and the impacted metrics (delta in recall, sample queries) so they can have a quick technical discussion.

incident-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-789 (severity: medium). Follow-up meeting scheduled tomorrow 9:00 AM PT.

Diego Romero: I'll own outreach to the renewal cohort and set a calendar block for remediation calls. Nina — can you send the AE one-pager and the sample query lists?

Nina Park: On it. Also recommending a single unified feedback form for affected customers to capture sample queries and severity — will share link in the email (short form, 3 fields).

Jules Martin (Legal): Approved the draft wording above. Keep the initial message short; save pricing/credit specifics for the 1:1.

Samir Roy: Thanks, team. After we finish outreach let's capture responses (accepted reindex, decline, requested credits) in the CS tracker so renewal team can update risk flags.

Nina Park: Agreement — updating the tracker now and will flag any escalations. Will send the general note within the next hour after legal ack. :white_check_mark:
